usage: agentbreeder tool log [-h] [--project DIR] [--environment ENV]
                             [--since D] [--agent NAME] [--limit LIMIT]
                             [--content] [--json]
                             REF

List the calls the agent runtime recorded for a registry tool, newest first.
The log is what the runtime claims it called; results are not stored (see the
trace).

positional arguments:
  REF                tool/NAME (every version) or tool/NAME@X.Y.Z

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project DIR      The stack's directory
  --environment ENV  Whose stack state to use (default: the only one)
  --since D          90s, 10m, 2h or 2026-11-11T09:00:00Z (default 24h, at
                     most 720 hours back)
  --agent NAME       Only this agent's calls (runtime >= 1.2.0)
  --limit LIMIT      1 to 1000 (default 100)
  --content          Also show arguments and error text
  --json
